Enterprise AI Policy & Deployment Guidelines (Page 1)
1.1 Enterprise LLM Infrastructure: Acme Corp utilizes centralized LLM endpoints.
1.2 Approved Models: Production workloads use Llama 3.1 8B/70B and Groq LPU inference.
1.3 Real-Time Response Requirements: Interactive chatbots must maintain sub-100ms TTFT.

1.4 All user prompts must pass automated sanitization filters before processing.
Confidential - Acme Corp Enterprise AI Documentation

Data Privacy, Compliance & Access Controls (Page 2)
2.1 Data Classification: Documents containing PII or proprietary trade secrets require Tier-1 access.
2.2 Encryption Standards: Vector databases and document storage use AES-256 encryption at rest.

2.3 Data Retention Policy: Interaction logs and conversation histories are retained for exactly 30 days.
2.4 Audit Trails: Every user query and retrieved passage is hashed for compliance auditing.
Confidential - Acme Corp Enterprise AI Documentation

RAG Architecture & Vector Search Configuration (Page 3)
3.1 Chunking Strategy: PDF documents are split into 300-character chunks with a 50-character overlap.
3.2 Semantic Embeddings: Dense 384-dimensional vectors are generated using all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
3.3 Vector Index: ChromaDB provides sub-millisecond retrieval with Cosine Similarity and HNSW.

3.4 Top-K Parameter: The retriever fetches the top-2 most relevant document chunks per query.
Confidential - Acme Corp Enterprise AI Documentation

Message History, Memory Limits & Trimming Rules (Page 4)
4.1 Conversational Memory: Chatbots maintain session state using LangChain MessagesPlaceholder.
4.2 Follow-Up Question Handling: Pronouns and references are resolved against past conversation turns.

4.3 Sliding-Window Trimming: To avoid token overflow, only the last 3 interaction turns are retained.
4.4 Context Guardrails: If retrieved context does not contain the answer, reply I do not know.
Confidential - Acme Corp Enterprise AI Documentation

Escalation Protocols & FAQ (Page 5)
5.1 Incident Escalation: Hallucination rates exceeding 2 percent must be escalated to the AI Safety Team.
5.2 Support Contact: For enterprise support, reach out to ai-support@acmecorp.internal.
5.3 System Maintenance: Scheduled indexing windows occur every Sunday at 02:00 UTC.

5.4 Version Control: This manual is valid for Q4 2026 Enterprise AI deployments.
Confidential - Acme Corp Enterprise AI Documentation
